nodes.description: Owned.owner: address of the current contract owner, set from msg.sender in the constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Owned.newOwner: pending owner address written by transferOwnership and promoted in acceptOwnership.
YFA.symbol: token ticker string, set once in the constructor.
YFA.name: human readable token name, set once in the constructor.
YFA.decimals: token decimal precision, set to 18 in the constructor.
YFA._totalSupply: total token supply minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
YFA.balances: mapping(address => uint) of token balances, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
YFA.allowed: nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances, mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
Caller-controlled address used as owner, spender and account key throughout Owned, YFA and the token transfer functions.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): checked addition guarded by require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): checked subtraction guarded by require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): checked multiplication guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): division guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment.
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, emits OwnershipTransferred and rotates owner.
YFA constructor: sets symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and credits the full supply to a fixed address.
YFA.totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using unchecked subtraction.
YFA.balanceOf(address tokenOwner): returns balances[tokenOwner].
YFA.transfer(address to, uint tokens): debits msg.sender via safeSub and credits 'to' via safeAdd, then emits Transfer.
YFA.approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
YFA.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): debits balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] and credits 'to'.
YFA.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
YFA.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): stores the allowance and then calls receiveApproval on the spender contract.
YFA fallback function payable that unconditionally reverts, refusing all plain ETH transfers.
YFA.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens): onlyOwner rescue that makes an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
Checked addition c = a + b inside safeAdd, the only defence against uint overflow in this codebase.
Checked subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub, guarding against uint underflow.
Checked multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul, guarded by a division check.
Division c = a / b inside safeDiv, guarded against division by zero.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) executed while the allowance state is already updated, with no reentrancy guard.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an owner-supplied contract address.
transfer(address to, uint tokens) destination parameter.
transfer(address to, uint tokens) amount parameter.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) spender key parameter.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) allowance amount parameter.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) source account parameter.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) destination account parameter.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) amount parameter.
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) spender contract address parameter.
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) allowance amount parameter.
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) arbitrary bytes forwarded to the spender callback.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) external contract address parameter.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) amount parameter.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) candidate owner parameter.
Return local c holding the result of a + b inside safeAdd.
Named return variable 'balance' of balanceOf.
Named return variable 'remaining' of allowance.

edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership reads owner to emit OwnershipTransferred and overwrites it with newOwner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner and then resets newOwner to address(0).
transferOwnership stores the caller-supplied _newOwner into newOwner.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply in its return expression.
YFA constructor assigns the fixed 55000e18 supply to _totalSupply.
transfer reads and writes balances for msg.sender and the destination.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external callback.
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
transferAnyERC20Token is onlyOwner and forwards rescued tokens to owner.
YFA constructor assigns the symbol string.
YFA constructor assigns the name string.
YFA constructor assigns decimals = 18.
Owned constructor sets owner = msg.sender, the only privilege assignment of the contract.
transferOwnership is gated by require(msg.sender == owner).
acceptOwnership is gated by require(msg.sender == newOwner).
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using caller-controlled input.
approve writes the allowance under the msg.sender key.
transferFrom spends the allowance keyed by msg.sender.
approveAndCall writes state and then calls an attacker-chosen spender contract with msg.sender as argument.
msg.sender is forwarded to the untrusted spender contract via receiveApproval.
fallback rejects any incoming value regardless of which msg.sender sends it.
safeAdd performs c = a + b, an overflow-prone addition guarded only by require(c >= a).
safeSub performs c = a - b, guarded against underflow by require(b <= a).
safeMul performs c = a * b with a division-based overflow guard.
safeDiv performs c = a / b with a zero-divisor guard.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on the spender contract, allowing re-entry into token functions with no reentrancy guard.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call to an owner-supplied token contract.
transfer delegates the balance debit to safeSub.
transfer delegates the balance credit to safeAdd.
transferFrom uses safeSub for both balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit balances[to].
'to' is the destination key written in balances by transfer.
'tokens' is the amount moved between balances in transfer.
'tokens' is passed as the subtrahend to safeSub.
'tokens' is passed as the addend to safeAdd.
'spender' becomes the second key of the allowed mapping in approve.
'tokens' is stored verbatim as the approved allowance.
'from' is the debited account in transferFrom.
'to' is the credited account in transferFrom.
'tokens' is the transferred amount in transferFrom.
'tokens' flows into safeSub calls inside transferFrom.
'spender' is the allowance key and the address that will be called back.
'spender' is cast to ApproveAndCallFallBack and invoked, enabling a malicious callback.
'tokens' is stored as the allowance before the callback.
Arbitrary 'data' bytes are forwarded to the untrusted receiveApproval callback.
'tokenAddress' is cast to ERC20Interface inside transferAnyERC20Token.
'tokenAddress' determines which external contract is called by the rescue function.
'tokens' is the amount requested from the external token contract.
'_newOwner' is written into the newOwner privilege slot.
'_newOwner' must equal msg.sender for acceptOwnership to succeed.
Local c receives the result of the unguarded-arithmetic addition a + b.
Local 'balance' is the value returned by balanceOf.
Local 'remaining' is the value returned by allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: The 'to' parameter only exists to key the balances mapping inside transfer, so it is normalized into that core function.
The 'tokens' amount parameter is consumed entirely by transfer's balance updates and is folded into the function.
'spender' is only used as the allowance key written by approve.
'tokens' is only used as the allowance value written by approve.
'from' is only the debited account key inside transferFrom.
'to' is only the credited account key inside transferFrom.
'tokens' is only the moved amount inside transferFrom.
'spender' is both the allowance key and the callback target of approveAndCall.
'tokens' is the allowance value stored by approveAndCall.
'data' is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call and belongs to that unsafe operation.
'tokenAddress' is the address of the external contract invoked, so it is folded into the external-call operation.
'tokens' is only the amount forwarded by the owner-gated rescue function.
'_newOwner' is stored directly into the newOwner privilege slot by transferOwnership.
Local c is just the storage of the a + b arithmetic result inside safeAdd.
Named return variable 'balance' is the sole output of balanceOf.
Named return variable 'remaining' is the sole output of allowance.
